visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with dark hair and a grey cardigan is sitting at a white desk, focused on a large textbook. She is holding a pen, and there are various notebooks open in front of her. The background shows a well-lit living room with neutral colors. (2) A man in a white T-shirt approaches and sits beside her. They engage in a conversation; she looks up briefly while he gestures with his hands. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the desk surface. Hands place several currency notes (Taiwanese dollars) on the paper. The girl picks them up and looks puzzled. (4) The girl stands up and walks toward the man who is now sitting on a sofa playing video games with a white controller. She points to the money, looking frustrated and expressive with her hands. (5) The man pauses his game, looks at the camera, and holds up a silver rectangular box of 'Nutrifuel' supplements. The background reveals shelves and home decor. (6) A sequence shows the girl swallowing a capsule with water and then returning to her studies with a more alert and positive expression. Close-ups of the supplement packaging are shown. (7) A new character, a woman with pink-highlighted hair, enters the living room and joins the dialogue. She talks animatedly toward the camera. (8) The final scene shows the man and the woman standing in the middle of the room. The man walks out of the frame, leaving the woman looking confused as she continues her monologue.
